title: Why Great White Sharks Actually Can Stop Swimming

scenes.text: Great White sharks must swim 30 miles each day to stay alive
scenes.query: Great White shark daily swimming distance

scenes.text: About 70% of shark species use ram ventilation, forcing water over gills by moving forward
Great whites can store enough oxygen to pause for up to five minutes while hunting
scenes.query: great white shark oxygen storage duration

scenes.text: But many sharks, like nurse sharks, have spiracles that let them breathe while completely still
scenes.query2: shark species that rest without swimming

scenes.text: Follow if you love learning something new.

description: You’ll think all sharks are forced to cruise forever, but some have a secret breathing trick. Dive deeper with us!
